text:
mira: flagged during routine telemetry scan: partner webhook secret in plaintext in logs for partner=acme. redacted value in-place. urgent rotation + containment needed.
ops-bot: secret-detect v1.2 triggered: 1 match in prod-telemetry. report: https://internal/reports/1711143730 (automated) :warning:
sara: can you paste the redacted line and when it was last seen?
mira: snippet: `2026-03-23T14:02:15Z INFO webhook delivered partner=acme env=prod webhook_key=****REDACTED****` last seen 2026-03-23T14:02:15Z UTC
security_oncall: treat as potential compromise. Suggested immediate actions: 1) suspend any jobs that use the partner key; 2) generate new key on our side and ask partner to rotate; 3) enforce RBAC deny on current path; 4) enable/confirm audit logging for Vault + KMS; 5) open SEC incident and assign owners. I'll file SEC-2026-17 now.
leo: storage context: KV v2 path `secret/data/partners/acme/webhook` currently at version=3. Ops plan: create new KV path `secret/data/partners/acme/webhook-v4`, write new key, update consumers to read v4 (canary then full), then deprecate v3. Use KMS key `projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/partner-rotate` for envelope.
sara: question: is rewrap enough or do we need to rotate? rewrap just changes encryption envelope; since plaintext leaked we must rotate and issue a new secret.
mira: partner replies they cannot rotate immediately (24h lag). they asked for indicators. we should revoke our outbound token and put a short-lived proxy token in place.
security_oncall: confirmed: rotation required. containment plan: A) revoke ingest-runner SA read on partner path; B) create ephemeral maintainer token (ttl=1h) for diagnostics; C) kick off rotation job; D) mark logs in retention window for redaction. need owner ack to run RBAC changes.
leo: proposed Vault policy to deny reads from old path:
```
vault policy write deny-acme-old - <<'EOF'
path "secret/data/partners/acme/webhook" {
  capabilities = ["deny"]
}
EOF
```
and then patch k8s secret-agent roleBinding to point to webhook-v4 and restart agent. will stage to staging first.
sara: ack. I'll run the rotation CI and update secret-sync. rotation script (ops sketch):
```
#!/bin/bash
OLD=secret/data/partners/acme/webhook
NEW=secret/data/partners/acme/webhook-v4
NEW_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
vault kv put ${NEW} key=${NEW_KEY} rotated_by=automation
# encrypt with KMS
printf "%s" "$NEW_KEY" | gcloud kms encrypt --location global --keyring rw --key partner-rotate --plaintext-file - --ciphertext-file /tmp/new_key.ct
# rollout: update config map -> restart secret-agent (canary)
```
ops-bot: ci pipeline `rotations/partners/acme/1711143730` queued by sara.
mira: also: enable vault audit device (file) and confirm KMS admin audit sink to security project for the window. need to capture token activity and any reads to the path.
security_oncall: commands to run: `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit_acme.log` and validate GCP logs for `partner-rotate` key. set retention 90d and add alert on reads to old path.
leo: i'll prepare a small terraform change for the policy + k8s roleBinding so we can fast-track. keeping change minimal to avoid long review.
sara: task assignments: sara -> rotation CI + k8s sync; leo -> policy + tf diff; mira -> partner comms and redaction timeline; security_oncall -> incident tracking, audit hooks, alerts. i'll update SEC-2026-17 and ping eng-sre for log-scrub ETA. :thumbsup:
mira: please run a post-rotation search across log retention window to confirm no additional leaks.
security_oncall: post-rotation checklist: 1) delete old secret version(s) from KV v2; 2) revoke any tokens/keys that had access; 3) run detection across logging buckets & export results to SEC ticket; 4) coordinate final rotation confirmation with partner.
sara: will update ticket with CI run output and canary rollout notes.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled in 30m to check progress on SEC-2026-17.
mira: will add proof-of-action to ticket once rotation and RBAC deny are complete. thanks everyone.
